summary.text: Tonya Pfaff is a Democratic member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 43, assumed office on November 7, 2018, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists Amy Lore (R) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Tonya Pfaff has taught math at West Vigo High School and later at Terre Haute North Vigo.
Pfaff succeeded Clyde Kersey (D) in District 43, and after her election she became the ranking minority member of the Natural Resources Committee.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists her on the Agriculture and Rural Development, Education, and Ways and Means committees.
